title: Sustainable AI: Experiences, Challenges & Recommendations
problem: AI/ML applications on HPC systems require proper configuration to achieve optimal performance and energy efficiency, while power and energy measurement remains challenging across diverse HPC and cloud-like virtualized platforms.
motivation: As AI/ML workloads become increasingly prevalent in scientific computing, understanding how to minimize their environmental impact through energy-efficient deployment on HPC systems is critical.
method: The authors use MLPerf HPC's DeepCAM benchmark to systematically assess and measure energy efficiency of ML applications across different hardware platforms, identifying framework integration challenges in traditional HPC environments and characterizing measurement difficulties on HPC and virtualized systems.
key_novelty: Systematic energy efficiency assessment of ML workloads on HPC systems using standardized benchmarks and proposing actionable best practices for sustainable AI configuration.
contributions: Energy efficiency assessment of ML applications across different hardware platforms using MLPerf HPC's DeepCAM benchmark
Identification of ML framework integration challenges in traditional HPC environments
Characterization of power and energy measurement challenges on HPC and cloud-like virtualized systems
Best practice recommendations for optimizing sustainable AI/ML workloads on HPC systems
limitations: Limitations not explicitly discussed in abstract; focus is on challenges and recommendations rather than identified approach limitations.
